Enter long on the first sign of strength or the first touch of the VWAP band after acceptance.
The first pullback after a strong break is the highest probability setup.
Price must break out of the VWAP value area to initiate price discovery.
Price must spend significant time or close multiple consecutive candles outside the VWAP value area.
The stop goes a few points below the testing candle.
The target is either a revisit of the recent highs.
The target is scalp to the midpoint of the distance.
